sources.title: Pillow 12.3.0 Image.crop and Image.resize
sources.authority_reason: Original image-operation implementation maintained by the Pillow project.
sources.inspection_note: Read Image.crop/_crop lines 1369–1414 and resize lines 2329–2369. Crop returns a rectangle; resize consumes its supplied source, requested size is width/height, RGB default is BICUBIC. These operations do not take missing original pixels as extra inputs.

sources.title: Pillow 12.3.0 handbook: resampling filters
sources.authority_reason: Official Pillow handbook describing the implementation filter contracts.
sources.inspection_note: Read resampling section lines 162–208: geometric operations may map multiple inputs to one output; BOX uses equal weights, bilinear/cubic combine contributing pixels; nearest picks one and ignores the others. Supports possibility of small feature/background mixing, not every filter doing averaging.
